data.title: La Tilia
data.about:
La Tilia at Villanova by Dubai Properties is the newest phase in the heart of Dubailand, offering a perfect blend of modern living and natural serenity. This gated community is designed for families, featuring 3 and 4 bedroom townhouses that balance contemporary architecture with lush green surroundings. Spacious interiors, expansive balconies, and floor-to-ceiling windows create seamless indoor-outdoor living spaces, encouraging a connection with nature.  

The community is thoughtfully crafted to enrich daily life, with amenities such as a central park, cycling and jogging tracks, a beach pool, and fitness zones. Families can enjoy kids’ play areas, sports courts, and gathering spaces, fostering an active and vibrant lifestyle. Strategically located near Emirates Road and major highways, La Tilia ensures easy access to key destinations like Downtown Dubai and Global Village. It’s a harmonious blend of convenience, tranquility, and connectivity, offering an exceptional standard of family living.

characteristics_module.title: Explore the Next Chapter of Villanova
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Prime Location: Ideally situated in Dubailand with seamless access to Emirates Road and major highways.  
  • Family-Centric Living: Gated community designed for families, offering safety, comfort, and privacy.  
  • Modern Townhouses: Spacious 3- and 4-bedroom units with contemporary architecture and natural surroundings.  
  • Green Lifestyle: Expansive parks, landscaped trails, and open spaces for outdoor activities.  
  • Resort-Style Amenities: Beach pool, community pool, and fitness zones for relaxation and recreation.  
  • Active Living: Sports courts, jogging tracks, and cycling paths to encourage a healthy lifestyle.  
  • Community Vibe: Play areas, gathering zones, and retail spaces that foster neighborly connections.  
  • Eco-Friendly Design: Thoughtful layouts promoting sustainability and harmony with nature.  
  • Convenient Access: Close proximity to key landmarks like Downtown Dubai, Global Village, and Al Maktoum International Airport.  
  • Flexible Payment Plans: Attractive installment options tailored to diverse financial needs.

location_tile.title: La Tilia: Setting a New Standard of Family Living!
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
La Tilia at Villanova enjoys a prime location in Dubailand, offering exceptional connectivity to Dubai’s key destinations. Positioned along Emirates Road, it provides seamless access to major routes like Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road and Al Ain Road. With Downtown Dubai, Global Village, and Al Maktoum International Airport just minutes away, residents are always close to the city's vibrant landmarks. The community combines the tranquility of nature with the convenience of urban living, making it a perfect place to live.

  • 5 minutes to Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road
  • 7 minutes to Global Village
  • 7 minutes to Dubai Miracle Garden
  • 10 minutes to Motor City
  • 15 minutes to the Expo 2020 Site
  • 18 minutes to Al Maktoum International Airport
